name: The Sea Leaves Clues
jem_summary: Obtain one marine utility through its natural route: tooth shield, Grappling Squok or Flying Fish Boots. Then use the chosen utility; Blobfish oil and its floating effect is another alternative.

pages.title: The Sea Leaves Clues
pages.text: Ocean finds provide new ways to travel and defend yourself.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Frilled Sharks shed teeth attacking squid, a lost tentacle comes from whale hunts on giant squid, and Flying Fish can be bucketed. Craft the selected utility rather than owning a gifted finished item.
